scope: Representative human germline small-variant tools relevant to the ClinVar project; not an exhaustive catalog or performance benchmark.
method: Manual review of developer documentation, published methods and release/source metadata. Facts and URLs are bundled to reproduce this dated survey offline; rerunning does not refresh the literature.
version_policy: Releases identify the reviewed software, score export or publication, as stated. Pinned source revisions identify documentation/code, not downloaded model weights. No surveyed tool is executed here.
compute_policy: Compute entries summarize documented execution routes. CPU lookup guidance is a workflow inference, not a runtime benchmark.

tools.name: CADD
tools.variants: Coding and noncoding SNVs; short indels can be scored separately.
tools.inputs: GRCh37/GRCh38 chromosome, position, REF and ALT.
tools.access: Precomputed scores, web service and local scoring.
tools.compute: CPU lookup is the simplest route; local scoring needs annotation resources.
tools.license: Scores: non-commercial use; commercial use requires contacting the authors.
tools.training: Human-derived versus simulated variants; proxy labels rather than direct clinical labels.
tools.clinvar: ClinVar used for assessment; PolyPhen is an input feature trained on known disease variants.
tools.caution: Useful broad comparator, but annotation inheritance and clinical assessment prevent a blanket leakage-free claim.

tools.name: Evo2
tools.method: DNA language model; likelihood changes or frozen representations.
tools.variants: Reference/alternate DNA sequences; this project evaluates SNVs with 1,024-base contexts.
tools.inputs: DNA windows; pin checkpoint, strand treatment and scoring rule.
tools.access: Public code and model weights; project already has a frozen 1B workflow.
tools.compute: GPU inference. Project 1B runtime is documented in Q2; requirements vary by model and context.
tools.license: Repository and the selected Hugging Face checkpoint: Apache-2.0.
tools.training: Autoregressive training on OpenGenome2 DNA; the project classifier additionally uses training ClinVar labels.
tools.clinvar: Clinical variants used in published evaluation; exact sequence and annotation contamination are not established here.
tools.caution: A gene-disjoint classifier split does not prove that its pretrained DNA model never encountered those genes.

tools.name: SIFT4G
tools.method: Protein sequence conservation and tolerated amino-acid substitutions.
tools.variants: Missense substitutions; transcript/protein mapping is required for genomic SNVs.
tools.inputs: Protein FASTA queries and a homologous protein sequence database.
tools.access: Public local implementation; annotation databases must match the selected species and reference.
tools.compute: CPU supported; optional CUDA acceleration for database construction/scoring.
tools.license: Implementation: GPL-3.0; external sequence database terms are separate.
tools.training: Evolutionary protein sequence alignments; no clinical-label fitting in the core scoring method.
tools.clinvar: This review does not establish independence of every distributed database or later benchmark.
tools.caution: A protein-impact score is not a calibrated disease probability; missing mappings and alignments limit applicability.

tools.name: PolyPhen-2
tools.inputs: Protein accession, residue position and amino-acid substitution; genomic mapping is also available.
tools.access: Web interface, standalone software and precomputed annotations.
tools.compute: CPU lookup or local scoring with protein/structure databases.
tools.license: Academic instruction/research use; other use requires the authors' commercial license.
tools.training: HumDiv/HumVar include known disease/function variants and neutral comparators.
tools.clinvar: Disease variants can recur in ClinVar even though the original training sources were different.
tools.caution: Audit the exact model and training overlap; useful as a historical comparator, not an assumed independent reference.

tools.name: REVEL
tools.variants: Missense SNVs with valid protein/transcript mappings.
tools.inputs: Genomic alleles plus transcript/amino-acid mapping; some lifted GRCh38 positions are missing.
tools.compute: CPU lookup; relatively little work after downloading and indexing scores.
tools.license: Scores: non-commercial use; contact authors for other uses.
tools.training: HGMD disease variants and rare neutral variants; constituents bring their own training histories.
tools.clinvar: ClinVar was a published evaluation set; overlapping variants and inherited labels remain concerns.
tools.caution: Use only with an explicit overlap audit and report mapping failures rather than treating absent scores as benign.

tools.name: AlphaMissense
tools.method: Protein structure/evolution model with population-frequency supervision.
tools.variants: Human missense substitutions in the released transcript/protein catalog.
tools.inputs: GRCh37/GRCh38 alleles with transcript mapping, or protein substitution identifiers.
tools.access: Public precomputed predictions and reference code; trained weights are not provided.
tools.compute: CPU lookup of the score release; new inference cannot be reproduced from the published code alone.
tools.training: Human/primate population-frequency labels; core model is not fitted directly to ClinVar classifications.
tools.clinvar: Released scores are calibrated and category thresholds selected using ClinVar; clinical benchmarking is also reported.
tools.caution: Use continuous scores and audit calibration membership; do not describe this as wholly ClinVar-independent.

tools.name: EVE
tools.method: Protein-family generative model followed by mixture-model scoring.
tools.variants: Missense substitutions for proteins and positions covered by the released models.
tools.inputs: Protein/residue mapping for lookup; a protein-family MSA for new model fitting.
tools.access: Public score browser/downloads and code for rebuilding models.
tools.compute: CPU lookup; fitting new protein-family models requires MSA preparation and substantial compute.
tools.license: Code: MIT; confirm the terms of any separately downloaded dataset.
tools.training: Evolutionary MSAs; the core workflow requires no clinical labels.
tools.clinvar: ClinVar labels are supplied for evaluation, separate from MSA model fitting.
tools.caution: Coverage and homologous-sequence exposure still matter; external clinical calibration would need a separate audit.

tools.name: PrimateAI-3D
tools.release: 2023 method; reviewed PyTorch source revision pinned
tools.method: Protein-structure and evolutionary model informed by primate variation.
tools.inputs: Score lookup by genomic/protein mapping; local models use structure and evolutionary features.
tools.access: Browser and downloadable scores after an academic license agreement; source repository available.
tools.compute: CPU score lookup; new predictions require the model and structure/sequence resources.
tools.license: Scores: academic non-profit research agreement; commercial scores/models require separate licensing.
tools.training: Common human/primate variation with structural and evolutionary learning objectives.
tools.clinvar: The authors report clinical benchmarking without relying on clinical annotations for core training.
tools.caution: Exact population and protein overlap are not audited here; availability is gated by the score agreement.

tools.name: SpliceAI
tools.method: Sequence model of donor/acceptor gains and losses.
tools.variants: Genic SNVs and simple indels; predicts splicing changes, not all pathogenic mechanisms.
tools.inputs: VCF, matching genome FASTA and transcript/gene annotations.
tools.access: Local package and pretrained models; score resources also exist.
tools.compute: CPU supported; GPU useful for inference. Use the model's required flanking DNA.
tools.license: Code: PolyForm Strict 1.0.0; models: CC BY-NC 4.0; commercial use needs a license.
tools.training: Annotated splice sites from primary DNA sequence.
tools.clinvar: Clinical evaluation is separate from the splice-site objective; exact external model exposure is unverified.
tools.caution: Splice disruption is not equivalent to pathogenicity; audit genome/annotation versions and expanded context overlap.

tools.name: Pangolin
tools.method: Multi-tissue splice-site strength from DNA sequence.
tools.variants: Genic substitutions and simple indels under the command-line restrictions.
tools.inputs: VCF/CSV, genome FASTA and an annotation database derived from GTF.
tools.access: Public code and packaged model weights; custom-sequence inference supported.
tools.compute: CPU supported; upstream recommends a GPU when available.
tools.license: Repository: GPL-3.0; annotation/reference data have separate terms.
tools.training: RNA-splicing measurements across tissues and species.
tools.clinvar: Published pathogenic-variant evaluation does not establish absence of overlap in upstream sequence or annotation data.
tools.caution: A suitable open splicing comparator after annotation matching and checks for overlapping longer windows.

tools.name: PromoterAI
tools.method: Promoter variant effects on gene expression.
tools.variants: Promoter SNVs; local interface also accepts normalized indels.
tools.inputs: Chromosome, position, REF, ALT, strand and reference FASTA; documented context is 20,480 bases.
tools.access: Precomputed promoter SNV scores after license agreement; local inference interface available.
tools.compute: CPU/GPU supported; using precomputed scores avoids model execution.
tools.license: Code: PolyForm Strict 1.0.0; score access is academic/non-commercial; other use needs licensing.
tools.training: Regulatory profiles across species; fine-tuning workflow uses GTEx variants.
tools.clinvar: Exact clinical benchmark/calibration overlap was not established in this review.
tools.caution: Expression direction and magnitude are not a universal pathogenicity score; context exceeds Q1's grouping window.

tools.name: AlphaGenome
tools.release: 2026 Nature model; research source revision pinned
tools.method: Long-context prediction of expression, splicing and chromatin tracks.
tools.variants: DNA sequence changes affecting molecular regulation; not a direct missense protein-damage classifier.
tools.inputs: Genomic interval and variant, chosen tissues and output/scoring strategy; up to 1 Mb of DNA.
tools.access: Hosted API and released local model weights, with model terms to accept.
tools.compute: API avoids local inference; upstream recommends at least an H100 GPU for its research implementation.
tools.license: Code: Apache-2.0; weights and API have separate non-commercial model/service terms.
tools.training: Functional genomic tracks from human/mouse and public annotation datasets.
tools.clinvar: ClinVar used in splicing evaluation; downstream scoring/selection and training-region exposure need audit.
tools.caution: Reserve for a regulatory experiment with predefined tissue/scorer and compatible context grouping; not a drop-in disease score.

shortlist.reason: Add CADD lookup alongside the existing Evo2 zero-shot baseline; cover the pilot broadly and audit inherited clinical annotations.
Use available continuous scores; report transcript/protein coverage and review clinical calibration or protein-family exposure.
Compare splice effects on an explicitly defined subset; prefer an executable route with acceptable licensing and recheck longer contexts.
Use only with a defined promoter/tissue target and a frozen scoring rule; these require additional context and access planning.

evaluation_rules: Any later benchmark must retain Q1 membership in data/clinvar-train-pilot.vcf and data/clinvar-test-pilot.vcf; the latter is validation.
Use the same eligible variants for pairwise comparisons; report missing-score coverage separately and never assign missing scores to the benign class.
Pin score files/checkpoints, reference assembly and transcript release. Predictor inputs must exclude ClinVar clinical assertions and label-derived annotations.
Fit any calibration, preprocessing or classifier on training only; use validation for choices. Record external clinical training, calibration and evaluation exposure.
Re-audit overlap using each model's actual sequence windows. The 1,024-base Q1 check does not certify 10 kb, 20 kb or 1 Mb contexts; stop if incompatible.
Q8 reads no variant labels, fits no models and reports no measured coverage or accuracy. Its checks validate survey provenance, not absence of biological contamination.
conclusion: Existing tools span broad variant ranking, missense effects, splicing and regulation. For this project, start with CADD alongside Evo2, then AlphaMissense/EVE for missense and Pangolin or SpliceAI for splicing. These are scope-based baseline choices, not a performance ranking; external training and calibration overlap still require auditing.
